Keral ke vaynad men rahne vali aaisa chhah sal ki hain. vo kyutis laiksa nam ki ek reyar jenetik bimari se pirit hain. is bimari ki vajah se aaisa kisi buzurg ki tarah nazar aati hain. aaisa ko pyar se unke ghar men thakku bulate hain, vo skul jati hain, dans karti hain aur draing banati hain. aaisa bari hokar doktar banna chahti hain. dekhie unki kahani.
Prodyusar nandini vellaisami
